brief: The canvas depicts an organic, glowing expanse of luminous shapes that resemble bacterial cultures. These soft, ephemeral clusters drift and weave across the surface, following the slow, exploratory search pattern of a slime mould. The color palette is dominated by deep, bioluminescent glows, creating a continually shifting, meditative flow.

statement: This sketch depicts an organic, glowing expanse of luminous shapes resembling bacterial cultures drifting across the canvas. Using noise-based movement, each culture cluster follows a slow, exploratory search pattern that mimics slime mould behavior. The bioluminescent palette—deep blues and greens with varying opacity—creates a meditative flow as clusters weave through space. The visual effect emerges from many soft, irregular polygons moving independently yet in harmony, creating an ever-shifting landscape of living light.
